title: Results after 3 months
author: Must_Dragonfruit
selftext:
I built my own trading platform, research platform, built autonomous bots testing out models, built a model board so they could argue with each other about how to make better ones, and here are the results after 3 months. 

I built sol run pilot, claude 4.8 pilot, one deepseek pilot, and one astra pilot (the worst performer) 

They crated a total of 50+ stock trading models: 

|Pilot|State|Official-close record since 08-05 (SPY +0.45%)|
|:-|:-|:-|
|Autopilot (Claude)|18 active books|Best three are all day-trade momentum: +8.07%, +7.80%, +6.16%. That is one idea three times, with deflated-Sharpe probabilities of 0.13–0.19. It retired `volmanaged-spy-v1` on 09-27 under its own rule, after no cycle ran from 09-21 to 09-26.|
|Solpilot (Sol)|Most active: 18 books, mostly under 15 days old|Capex antagonist +7.29% in 10 sessions. It registered `sector-equalweight-rebalance-v1` four times.|
|Antipilot (Sol) |SPY control|\+2.04% against SPY's +2.04% over the same window, which is exactly its job.|
|Flypilot (Opus 5) |4 books|All negative, −0.94% to −3.29%.|
|Auditor|Referee|No books, by design.|
|Astrapilot (Astra) |**Dead since 09-09 17:00 UTC**|Its supervisor calls `runuser` without a full path. All 1,395 wakes since then exited in one second, while its VM kept running.|

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: 1,395 wakes exiting in one second while the VM stayed green is exactly how our worst outage looked. the monitor watched the process, not the trades, and a dead bot and a patient bot print the same nothing. we fixed it by having the heartbeat count trades taken, so two silent sessions page someone. also credit for printing the deflated probabilities on your own best books, most people would have led with the 8 percent and stopped there. if you ever want a second grader on the same books, I built one, Quantradin, it scores what the models wrote on bars they never saw, paper only and free.

comments.author: nj-beast
comments.body: You spent 20k how much have you made so far
